counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of bilateral infiltrates (only right lung patchy infiltrates)
No mention of proteinuria or other preeclampsia criteria
No arterial blood gas confirming respiratory failure
decisive_items: Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue: Positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus, negative for influenza B virus and 16 other common respiratory viruses
Patchy infiltrates in the upper and middle lobes of the right lung
Oxygen saturation: 86% on room air, 96% on 10L oxygen
response.rationale: R2 is the only candidate with a definitive etiologic confirmation (PCR positive for influenza A H3N2) directly matching the vignette's most specific test. R4 captures the respiratory syndrome but lacks the causative agent and overstates ARDS without bilateral infiltrates or formal criteria. R3 and C1 are generic respiratory failure labels, less specific than R4. R5 is unsupported by only one blood pressure reading and lacks other preeclampsia features.

rejected.why: Respiratory failure is a consequence, not the most likely primary diagnosis; lacks etiologic specificity.
Append-only completion of R3 adds 'acute' but does not address the underlying cause; redundant with R3.
Single elevated blood pressure without proteinuria or other preeclampsia criteria; not the most likely diagnosis.
